headline: Sensex tumbles over 500 points as IT, FMCG, and PSU banks drag Nifty below 22,400

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Selling pressure in IT and FMCG sectors dragging key indices lower.
Nifty PSU Bank index falling over 1% during intraday trade.
Top losers including Tech Mahindra, ITC, SBI, and Coal India weighing on market sentiment.
Profit-taking following prior week's strong gains.
whatHappening: Sensex declines over 500 points while Nifty slips below the 22,400 mark.
Equity fund inflows in India surged by 31% in September.
Jio IPO reported to be potentially valued at Rs 11 lakh crore.
Gold prices drop Rs 1,450 per 10g while silver falls Rs 1,400 per kg.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices opened lower on October 12, with the Sensex cracking over 500 points and Nifty sliding below 22,400.
The market decline was primarily led by weakness in IT, FMCG, and PSU banking stocks.
Key individual stock movements included TCS following AI hiring announcements, Can Fin Homes after Q2 results, and Cupid facing a 3% dip.
